news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.05 (vs ₹0.012 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.05 (up from ₹0.012 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹11.8m (up 53% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹8.95m (up ₹7.63m from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 76% (up from 17% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was primarily driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 7% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 4% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
